item.title: Outside 27 Chalcot Crescent NW1 8YE, 11th August
item.description:
I wanted to clarify that the twisted "two-way" street sign I have reported today is a REPEAT of the problem I previously reported in Sep 2025, which was promptly addressed last year. The photo just loaded was taken today and followed my nearly having a head-on collison yesterday as someone was driving yet again the wrong way down Chalcot Crescent, potentially misled by the road sign being twisted or struck so that is visible to drivers reaching the Chalcot Crescent / Rothwell St jct from Chalcot Square and possibly being distracted from seeing the seemingly contradictory No Entry sign. It is unclear whether the sign is twisted again following impact from a vehicle, from insecure fastening or human mischief, but again it poses a threat to safety.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 25, Chalcot Crescent, Chalk Farm, Greater London
